plugins.prepareCmd: ./gradlew clean test :app:admcp:distZip :app:admcp:mcpbStage -PreleaseVersion=${nextRelease.version} --no-daemon && ./node_modules/.bin/mcpb pack app/admcp/build/mcpb app/admcp/build/distributions/admcp-${nextRelease.version}.mcpb && node scripts/prepare-mcp-registry.mjs ${nextRelease.version} && ./mcp-publisher validate && cd app/admcp/build/distributions && sha256sum admcp-${nextRelease.version}.zip > admcp-${nextRelease.version}.zip.sha256 && sha256sum admcp-${nextRelease.version}.mcpb > admcp-${nextRelease.version}.mcpb.sha256

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
admcp <%= nextRelease.version %>

Local-first MCP server for Android debugging.

Download `admcp-<%= nextRelease.version %>.zip` for the portable distribution, or `admcp-<%= nextRelease.version %>.mcpb` for one-click installation in MCPB-compatible clients. Requires JDK 21.

The SHA-256 checksums are attached.
